publications.title: Acicular berthierine-chamosite in coal and lung cancer tissues of Xuan Wei, China
publications.summary: Investigates the occurrence of acicular berthierine-chamosite minerals in coal from Xuan Wei, Yunnan—a region with among the highest lung cancer rates in China. Links Fe-rich chamosite particles in domestic coal combustion to carcinogenic mechanisms and oxidative stress in bronchial epithelial cells.

publications.title: Scaling green hydrogen and CCUS via cement-methanol co-production in China
publications.summary: Proposes integrated cement-methanol co-production pathways to scale green hydrogen and carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) in China, addressing decarbonization of industry and energy sectors.
